title: teucrium luteum subsp. latifolium
intro: Teucrium luteum subsp. latifolium, commonly known as the golden germander, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various ailments such as digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of golden germander are attributed to its ability to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, which can help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified as the key compounds contributing to the plant's medicinal value.
